tasks.title: DeviceRepositoryImpl escalation ladder policy (FR-36)
tasks.description: Edit observeDiscovery's poll loop to implement the BUDGETED ESCALATION, not a pre-emptive call (the pre-first-poll variant was WITHDRAWN on measured evidence — a wedged daemon hangs start-server, so an unconditional call would burn the full 15s watchdog every poll, a worse livelock). Ladder: (1) ListDevices at the existing 3_000L HostCommandTimeoutMs; success emits Found/NoDeviceFound, done. (2) On a TIMEOUT-classified failure ONLY (isTimeout() true — never a parse error, never a non-zero exit): call startServer() under DaemonStartTimeoutMs. (3) If startServer() ITSELF times out, the daemon is wedged: call killServer() then startServer() again. (4) Still failing: emit PollFailed carrying the reason. Never loop silently. probe()'s not-found short-circuit still wins first, so a genuinely absent adb reports ToolMissing with no process spawned.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A timeout-classified ListDevices failure triggers exactly one startServer() call, never a pre-emptive call before the first poll.
If startServer() itself times out, killServer() then startServer() run in that order before the next ListDevices attempt.
A non-timeout failure (parse error, non-zero exit) spawns zero additional processes.
Every failure path that cannot recover emits PollFailed with the real reason; observeDiscovery never throws out of the flow.

tasks.expectedOutput: DeviceRepositoryImpl.kt's observeDiscovery loop implementing the 4-step ladder with a collector-local daemonStarted-style guard structure as needed.
tasks.hypothesis: Keeping the policy in the repository loop (not the datasource) makes it hardware-free testable under virtual time, and the loop is already where a failed poll becomes PollFailed.
outOfScope: Any pre-first-poll or unconditional startServer call — explicitly withdrawn and rejected

Install them, or point Rectify at an adb you already have.', cmd `brew install --cask android-platform-tools`, primary 'Locate adb…', secondary 'Retry'; err-nodevice (NoDeviceFound) title 'No Android device detected', body 'adb is running but sees nothing. On the phone, turn on USB debugging and tap Allow on the prompt.', cmd `adb kill-server && adb devices`, primary 'Restart adb', secondary 'Boot emulator instead', footer format `adb <version> · last poll <age>s ago · <attached> attached`; err-multi (MultipleDevices) title '<N> devices connected', body 'Pick one to mirror. Rectify keeps using it for this session.' — HONEST COPY, deliberately NOT the design's literal text. BACKLOG CORRECTION (events.jsonl 'copy-behaviour-mismatch', detail inputs/design-error-states.md CORRECTION 3): the design's verbatim sentence 'Rectify remembers it until you quit' is verified FALSE against the running code — MirrorViewModel.sessionDeviceId (line 79) is a plain MutableStateFlow<String?> with no persistence, and three separate paths null it: onSessionLost (line 184, the exact F-3 session-loss scenario), selectPlatform (190) and stopSession (246); data-preference-api holds no device-selection key at all.
